A '''planet''' was the site of a [[Battle of unidentified planet (Ngani Zho)|battle]] early in the [[Great Galactic War]]. The conflict was waged between [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ngani Zho]] and [[Imperial soldier]]s from of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="The Old Republic-The Lost Suns 4" />
